rows.help: The lead's and verifiers' share of the cost (merge reruns and re-rolled attempts aren't priced) over the merges whose solo cost is known: their workers' cost is the solo baseline, and the lead's cost is taken as spread evenly over the range's merges. ≥: a part isn't recorded.
rows.label: Process cost

rows.help: Important findings a later audit saw fixed, per 100 merges whose audits are kept: a solo session is taken to have shipped them.
rows.label: Important findings fixed

rows.help: Merges whose first test run failed (not a flake) and went back to their worker, per 100 merges the merges recorder saw: a solo session is taken to have merged them as they were.
rows.label: Test failures sent back

rows.help: Flaky tests a merge's rerun caught (the flake ledger), per 100 merges: a solo session is taken to have had no rerun to tell them apart.
rows.label: Flaky tests caught by reruns

rows.help: Merges since reverted, per 100 merges: what the process let through.
rows.label: Reverts

rows.help: Merges named by an incident the lead recorded after they merged, per 100 merges.
rows.label: Incidents

rows.help: Worker hours over the wall-clock hours with a task under way: a solo session works an hour an hour. A task counts as under way from its start to its end, audits and merges included.
rows.label: Hours of work per hour

rows.help: The minutes the lead's questions waited on your answer, per merged task: taken as your attention, which overstates it.
rows.label: Your minutes per merged task

rows.help: A merged task's worker time over your minutes on it: a solo session is taken to need you for every minute it works.
rows.label: Hands-off work per minute of yours

compared.method: Estimated, not measured: nothing was run solo. Solo is one plain Claude Code or Codex session per task, spending what the worker of the attempt that merged spent, with no lead, audits, merge test runs or re-rolls.
compared.title: Compared with working solo

figures.detail: Tasks created: none (n = 0) · the 7 days before: 0 vs 0; none (n = 0) · n < 10 in a week: no trend
figures.help: The tasks put on the board in each week, by where add_task said they came from: user_report (you reported it) against incident, log_watcher, flake and audit (the system found it); lead and other are neither; not said: tasks from before origins were kept. n: the tasks created that week.
figures.label: Bugs you reported vs found by the system

figures.detail: n = 0 merges: 0 questions, – of your waiting per task · the 7 days before: –, – waiting (n = 0) · n < 10 in a week: no trend
figures.help: The lead's questions to you about the week's merged tasks (whenever asked), and those about no task asked that week, per merged task; and the minutes they waited on your answer, per merged task. n: the week's merges.
figures.label: Questions per delivered task

figures.detail: n = 0 of 0 merges with a known cost: receipts – per task + the lead's share: Not recorded (no lead ledger covers the week) · the 7 days before: – (n = 0) · n < 10 in a week: no trend
figures.help: The receipts' estimated cost (workers and verifiers, Codex at its own prices) per merged task whose cost is known, plus the project lead's own cost: each day's spread over that day's merges in its project. Receipts don't carry the lead's share. n: the merges whose cost is known.
figures.label: Cost per merged task, with the lead's share

figures.detail: n = 0 of 0 merges installed, 0 not installed yet · the 7 days before: – (n = 0 of 0) · n < 10 in a week: no trend
figures.help: From a task's creation to the first install that contained its merge: the installed app (installed when its copy is dated) or a build a later merge's receipt records as the one that ran it, each holding every commit before its own. A merge no recorded build holds yet is not installed yet. n: the merges installed.
figures.label: Time to install

figures.detail: n = 0 messages: 0 you must act, 0 finished or a problem, 0 daily summary, 0 other · text replies and shell cards: Not recorded (no lead transcript found) · the 7 days before: 0 a day (n = 0: 0 you must act, 0 finished or a problem, 0 daily summary, 0 other) · n < 10 in a week: no trend
figures.help: What the project leads sent you, by the tool they used, never by what it says: you must act (ask_user, a vs-shell card), finished or a problem (post_update), the daily summary (post_update titled "Today:") and other (the lead's text replies in its chat, one per turn). Over the week's 7 days. n: the messages.
figures.label: Lead's messages to you per day

figures.detail: n = 0 messages: 0 acted on within a day · the 7 days before: – (n = 0) · n < 10 in a week: no trend
figures.help: Of the leads' messages to you, those you acted on within a day: a question answered (not withdrawn or decided on its timer), a shell card you ran or declined, an update or a reply followed by your message in the lead's chat. A message less than a day old with nothing yet isn't counted. n: the messages counted.
figures.label: Lead's messages you acted on
